description: Add a participant to a Conversation. For SMS / WhatsApp, pass MessagingBinding.Address (+E164 or whatsapp:+E164) + MessagingBinding.ProxyAddress (your Twilio number). For chat participants, pass Identity.

Attributes.description: JSON string of custom participant attributes

Identity.description: Chat identity (use for in-app chat participants)

MessagingBinding.Address.description: Participant's address: +E164 for SMS, whatsapp:+E164 for WhatsApp

MessagingBinding.ProxyAddress.description: Your Twilio number the participant messages with (E.164 or whatsapp:+E164)

name: add_conversation_participant
